title: The First Order Arrives on Jakku!
description: The First Order discovers Poe Dameron's mission, sending an army of Stormtroopers to capture the Resistance pilot and obtain the map with the clues to Luke Skywalker's whereabouts. The hum of ships landing at the edge of the village cues Poe and BB-8 to leave Lor San Tekka and retreat to his T-70 X-wing starfighter.
